scope: Shipping standalone HTML in Chromium memory. State/clock setup uses explicit diagnostics. Real input, view and rule code. No HTTP/file navigation or human participants.

tests.name: Built browser contains the new versioned mechanics, not the v3 bundle
Book availability distinguishes STORED from actionable READY
ICE plus SLOW queues visibly, rejects recast, then starts the saved duration
Pause and resume preserve queued spells and their exact timers
Real Enter immediately after landing applies no second typo penalty
The late-entry guard does not turn into permanent forgiveness
FIRE preserves typing and its cleared target is not penalized on immediate Enter
Typing after Tab lands on a spell returns to the word without dropping a letter
Returning from a spell with selected text preserves replacement editing
An empty playfield refills promptly after a correct word
Archive trial rest is signposted in the existing wave indicator
Final-word quota drains cleanly without spawning disposable extra cards
Chapter-one failure offers Retry rather than forcing a fresh campaign
Retry restores chapter resources and the identical opening word, without score farming
Play from post-defeat Records cannot silently replace the retry bookmark
How to play respects an existing Continue bookmark
Finale rejects repeated next-chapter actions rather than leaking into chapter 49
Practice records compare only the selected chapter
Practice stars survive save import without unlocking an uncleared campaign chapter
Continued old-rule scores are clearly archived instead of claiming a new-rule best
Ending Endless voluntarily records the score exactly once as retired
A storage-blocked browser does not falsely claim chapter progress was persisted
Holding Enter across a chapter transition does not advance twice or add a typo
Changing next-run difficulty in a paused menu never changes the active board
Concurrent spells and streaks share one non-overlapping feedback banner
Unchanged playfield layout renders queued spell feedback without overflow
No unhandled JavaScript exceptions in the mechanics browser audit
